enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn again. Stretch. Curl up. Remain still. Open eyes. Close eyes. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Place bowl on table. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Pick up spoon. Eat. Drink milk. Wipe mouth. Place bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to desk.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone call. Attend meeting. Take notes. Type report. Print document. File papers. Talk to coworker. Drink water. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue typing.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Walk outside. Check phone. Use restroom. Walk back to office.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open files. Type document. Make phone call. Attend meeting. Take notes. Reply to emails. File papers. Talk to coworker. Drink water. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue typing. Print document.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Taste. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water.

Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Stack plates. Carry plates to sink. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wash pots. Rinse pots. Dry pots. Put pots away. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Take out trash.

Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bed. Lie down. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch. Curl up. Remain still. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still.
